note: Literature confirms SPTAN1 variants cause autosomal dominant distal hereditary motor neuropathy (dHMN11) characterized by distal lower limb weakness and amyotrophy.

evidence.text: A nonsense variant in SPTAN1 was reported to cause autosomal dominant distal hereditary motor neuropathy, which is characterized by lower limb weakness and muscle atrophy.

source.title: A novel de novo SPTAN1 nonsense variant causes hereditary motor neuropathy in a Chinese family
source.quote: autosomal dominant distal hereditary motor neuropathy (... characterized by lower limb weakness and muscle atrophy.

evidence.text: SPTAN1 loss-of-function variants are documented causes of distal hereditary motor neuropathy manifesting with distal muscle weakness.

source.title: A heterozygous 9q34 deletion encompassing SPTAN1 as a cause of distal myopathy
source.quote: SPTAN1 loss-of-function variants have previously been reported to cause distal hereditary motor neuropathy
